body:
The earlier affinity fit produced nearly constant outputs and mixed supervision obscured which parameters had trained. This PR adds a modular, directly supervised model, explicit measurement/context contracts, training-support checks, and reproducible exact-versus-sampled peptide-availability experiments. It remains **draft**: the qualified biological system specified in #130 and #132 is incomplete.

## Model and data flow

- Shared sequence representations feed direct affinity/stability heads. Class II evaluates sliding registers and flanks; class I retains whole-peptide context.
- Optional annotation heads predict molecular species/context with explicit supplied values and overrides. Full paired-TCR scoring conditions on the receptor before pMHC-register pooling; validated TCR cohorts and TCRvdb access remain pending.
- APC inputs distinguish species, cell type, concurrent machinery states and cytokine exposure. Defaults carry provenance; supplied states override assumptions. Purified binding remains separate from APC context.
- Processing and MS response have separate features/readouts. Raw assay targets, training-only scaling, subset-specific allocation, feature/parameter support and compatible checkpoint transfer make the trained scope explicit. Exact resume retains optimizer/sampler/RNG state; GPU bitwise equivalence is not established.
- Biological sources use shared Hitlist query/materialization contracts with source quantities, missingness, inequalities, reused contributors, conflicting copies, parent alternatives and material uncertainty preserved.
- Experimental exact and sampled processing models cover short fragments/nonbinders. They are not yet fully integrated into mixed-assay training, and their inferred quantities are not validated APC concentrations.

## Biological evidence

| Task | Result | Scope and limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Local IC50, one epoch | Test RMSE 1.1613 vs ridge 1.2291 log10(nM); Spearman 0.5117 | Inspected peptide-disjoint splits/shared studies; class-II recall 0.0882 and 0/203 bounds satisfied. Full convergence and qualification unresolved. |
| HAP1 knockout response | Test RMSE 0.573380 vs calibrated precursor 0.631249; 9.167% gain | Same-study molecular-component holdout; mechanistic ERAP augmentation adds no gain. |
| Non-MHC measured MS1 | Test RMSE 0.449828 vs length 0.520456; 13.57% gain | Four held-out synthesized pools; purity/load/response confounded. |
| MAPP baseline composition | Exact test RMSE 0.415095 vs uniform 0.439892; 5.637% gain | Observed-candidate composition. Sequence vs length misses fixed 5% criterion; REINFORCE has no advantage. |
| Native-cell chemical response | Exact test RMSE 0.243207 vs condition 0.250953 | Combined exact/bounded loss improves only 0.59%; not concentration. |
| Macrophage MHC-I response | Test RMSE 0.139278 vs condition 0.120011 | Failed; almost constant without precursor. |
| Intact product/substrate kinetics | Fragmentation test RMSE 0.359038 vs direct 0.228184 | Failed same-peptide future-time forecast on one substrate/preparation. |
| Native HEK293T PSMD2 response | Sequence test RMSE 0.423308 vs zero 0.424407; 0.259% gain, paired 95% interval [-0.247%, 0.449%] | Failed fixed validation/test gate; prediction SD below 1% of target SD. |

These scopes differ; the rows are not a common benchmark. Full contracts and prior failures are in the [canonical experiment registry](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/experiment_log.md).

## Current representation investigation

The [native screen](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/2026-10-25_0630_codex_native-contrast-screen/README.md) uses 228 same-parent contrasts from 82 complete parent sequences across 81 dependency components. Fixed training/validation/test support is 158/38/32 contrasts and 55/8/18 components. Training-only CV selects ridge alpha 100 for the 61-feature sequence comparator; independent SVD replay verifies every coefficient, prediction and bootstrap result. The nearly constant output is a solved, strongly regularized model, not unfinished optimization. This finding does not diagnose the older full-model IC50 underfit.

The [new acquisition diagnostic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/2026-10-25_0711_codex_native-acquisition-sensitivity/README.md) uses only the original 158 training contrasts. All nine complementary acquisition comparisons are positive: median weighted Pearson **0.8382**, range **0.7669–0.8700**. Omitting one acquisition changes responses by **0.0447–0.0912 log10 RMS**, versus response RMS **0.4316**; **73.2%** retain their sign under every omission. Independent scalar replay checks 1,896 contributors against 1,284 original admitted quantity cells and reproduces 8,520 numerical values within 3.33e-15. No model is fitted and no outer rows are materialized.

The [boundary-context comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/68218543c1dd54082b66f8097ab52882354e560e/experiments/2026-10-25_0726_codex_native-boundary-context/README.md) is now complete. It adds two external residues on each side of the peptide to the fixed61feature map, using the original158training contrasts and nested5×3component CV. All214endpoint contexts reconcile to original parent/source spans; no original validation/test rows are materialized. Boundary development RMSE is **0.431426**, versus **0.432811** for61features, **0.429931** for length and **0.431604** for zero. Prediction SD is only **1.386%** of target SD. The0.3201%gain versus61features has a paired95%interval **[-0.0373%,0.7336%]**; all four fixed materiality gates fail.

All five boundary fits select alpha100. Every surviving130–137coefficient is solved; independent augmented-SVD reconstruction verifies all240fits,9,480inner predictions,632developmentOOF predictions,2,000bootstrap draws and the decision (149,250numerical checks, maximumdifference8.32e-14). All five local stages pass on their first numerical attempt; no optimizer grid or fold change followed the negative result.

Next is a [fixed reference-invariant objective comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/68218543c1dd54082b66f8097ab52882354e560e/experiments/agents/codex/plans/native-reference-invariant-development.md), retaining the same feature maps and frozen0726original-objective models. It will compare all within-parent pairs without treating them as independent biological samples. If this also fails, the plan explicitly stops further feature/optimizer expansion on this response-only cohort and moves to native baseline amounts and their observation contract. This next comparison is planned, not executed. Neither acquisition concordance nor the boundary experiment establishes an APC concentration model or an RL advantage.

A separate [temporal development comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/2026-10-25_0143_codex_intact-temporal-representation/README.md) found sequence-conditioned slopes improved development RMSE 8.772% over length, with nonconstant outputs; its paired interval includes zero. This is same-parent development evidence, not independent-protein transfer. Previously inspected outer outcomes remain closed.

## Exact versus sampled methods

The archived synthetic references include exact enumeration, REINFORCE, clipping × group-standardization factorials, sample reuse, reference KL, partial observation, multiset objectives and hybrids. Numerical success on synthetic data is separate from biological validation.

In the measured kinetic comparison, conditional-score hybrids retained exact forward probabilities/residuals, matched the failed exact model and cost 1.8–2.5× core runtime. They are not simulator-only RL or GRPO. No biological experiment yet establishes an RL advantage. The next mechanistic comparison requires a qualified shared representation, matched objectives and independent evaluation.

## Data admission, verification and remaining work

Native source [Hitlist #839](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/839) and registered contrast [#841](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/841) are merged. Source **2.0.37** and recipe **2.0.38** are published, with both distributions independently verified against the exact successful tested builds; [recipe receipt](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/2026-10-25_0711_codex_native-acquisition-sensitivity/results/recipe-release.json). Full hosted lint/unit/integration/coverage/docs gates passed. No shared environment was installed or modified. Source audits preserve all parent alternatives, original raw/LFQ distinctions, modified-form aggregation, matching-only observations, source zeros and unresolved specimen pairing. The HEK293T panel is not professional-APC calibration.

Both native diagnostic families pass their registered independent checks and unchanged local 20-minute/3-GiB limits; source/config/model records/predictions/tables/figures/runtime are committed. The earlier acquisition family preserves its initial sandbox monitoring preflight failure, which occurred before a numerical child; the boundary family has no numerical failures or retries. Local isolated lint/format passes. Presto CI40172565872 at0de1ef1 now passes both jobs. Hosted checks for this new6821854commit are pending; earlier passing checks do not certify this head.

Still required: independently confirmed biological transfer; precursor-relative APC quantities including undetected/sub-ligand products; machinery/transport/clearance constraints; MS observation calibration; qualified auxiliary/TCR cohorts; complete affinity/censoring qualification; integration and serving/promotion checks. Completion remains governed by #130, #132 and the completion spec. This PR remains draft and the full availability/concentration objective remains unachieved.
